scope: Additional integration/stabilization diagnostics during Rev G verification. These runs stopped early; their incomplete traces cannot establish circuit operation or hardware failure. The retained transient suite uses Gear and 1fF numerical shunts; it remains a simulator port without PSpice or physical correlation.

sources.note: Plaintext transcribed from manufacturer web response, preserving model parameters and notice; server rejected direct download
Original unencrypted TPS259620_TRANS.lib, Final 1.00, PSpice 17.2, 09Aug2019. Thermal timing is dissipation-dependent, not ambient-temperature calibrated.
